name: io.github.iowarp/cad-mcp
title: CLIO Cad
description: Model solid parts with build123d code, export STL and STEP, and rotate them in an interactive 3D view.

tools.name: build_part
tools.description: Model a part: run build123d code (from build123d import * is already done; assign the finished shape to result), export part.stl and part.step to <out_dir>/<name>, and open it in an interactive 3D view the person can rotate. Returns the size, bounds, volume, area, solid count and validity, and the file paths. Building the same name again replaces that part. See part_examples for worked scripts.

tools.name: show_part
tools.description: Open a part build_part made in the interactive 3D view again.

tools.name: part_mesh
tools.description: Triangles of a part for the 3D view to draw. Called by the view itself.

tools.name: remember_part_view
tools.description: Save the direction the part view looks from. Called by the view itself.

tools.name: list_parts
tools.description: The parts built in a folder (default the parts folder), with size and volume.

tools.name: part_examples
tools.description: Worked build123d scripts to start from: naca_wing_section, ahmed_car_body, cylinder, pipe_bend. Give name for one script; empty lists them all.

resources.name: cad_part
resources.description: An interactive 3D view of a part (three.js).

resources.name: capabilities
resources.description: Describe what the CAD MCP server can do.
